finding: An outsider can see that this is a read-only World snapshot, but cannot reliably decode the visual grammar on first viewing. The title/stamp and final footer establish habitat/read-only intent, while the central node network, cyan/gray state colors, yellow parcels, and tiny truncated labels appear before any plain-language mapping. The result can be read as an abstract network or dashboard rather than as a bounded habitat with aggregate traces and a receipt.
candidate_change: Add one persistent fixed-in-frame orientation legend directly under the title, before the habitat animation, and keep it visible through the end: "WORLD = center · DOTS = agents · CYAN = working · GRAY = idle · LINES = bounded links · YELLOW = aggregate task parcels · RECEIPT = read-only snapshot". Use the existing visual colors and terms only; add no new data, geometry, agent identifiers, reasoning, credentials, or claims.

source: scenes/film_world_bound_agents_v1.py:21-28 establishes only the title and READ-ONLY stamp.

canonical.observed: The source claim is a read-only habitat with bounded traces and receipts; the allowed source fields include agent id, model family, status, restart count, and aggregate counts. Aggregates are 15 selected agents, 13 working, 2 idle, and 60 tasks.

frame_observations: 0.8s: title/stamp and floor are visible; no orientation mapping is present.
4.0s: central WORLD ring and radial agent nodes/lines are visible; the visual roles are not explained on screen.
8.0s: the 13 WORKING · 2 IDLE · 60 TASKS summary is visible, while the agent labels form a small, low-legibility cluster.
10.2-11.2s: TASK PARCELS, RECEIPT, and the not-a-chat footer arrive late; the plain-language relationship between these elements is still not stated.

evidence.measurement_status: Observed evidence only; no outsider comprehension study has been run yet.

falsifier: Run a blind comprehension check at the delivered 854x480 size with viewers who have not seen the source. If at least 4 of 5 viewers, by 5 seconds, can correctly identify the center, node meaning, cyan/gray status distinction, and that the scene is not a chat/reasoning view without an added legend, this finding is falsified.
next_measurement: Render the proposal variant without changing the canonical data. A/B it against the current MP4 with 5 outsiders at 854x480. At 5 seconds ask four forced-choice questions (center, dots, cyan/gray, and whether the visual shows chat/reasoning); record accuracy and time-to-answer. Compare first-pass comprehension and false chat attribution; predeclare a pass as at least 4/5 viewers answering at least 3/4 correctly with zero unsupported-reasoning attribution.
